rule: a sentence or point the grounding gate confirms as wrong is cut; nothing is written in its place

cards.title: Cornell Students Plan Sit-In Over Alleged Fraternity Assault, University Hires Investigator

points.text: Breitbart News frames the newly released video from the Cornell investigation as showing "witnesses told Cornell investigators Jane Doe consented to group sex," while ABC News and Newsweek describe the fraternity members as saying they "heard it was all consensual" or "the general rumor... Was that it was a consensual thing," with an investigator questioning how they knew.
points.message: summary quotes "the general rumor", which appears in none of the source articles: quote it as written or paraphrase it
